lead: There is a monster in the building, specifically on one side of it.
summaryOneLine: There is a monster in the building, specifically on one side of it.
articleBodyHtml:
Monster in the Building

There is a monster in the building, specifically on one side of it.

Possession of an Item

The group has only one item.

Teams and Survival

The characters are alive and split into two teams.

Urgency and Action

There is a call for action or stopping something.

Rodent Behavior

There is uncertainty about what the rodent does.

Trauma and Aftermath

The characters are discussing events following a traumatic experience.

Dancing with a Mannequin

Someone wants to dance with a mannequin.

Instructions and Interaction

There is an instruction to spray down and speak to a person.

Returning to a Location

The characters are discussing returning to a previous location.

Observing and Following an Animal

Someone is observing a small animal and wants to follow it.

Saving for Future Items

The characters are discussing saving for future items and that this is the last one.

Exit Options

The characters are discussing exit options.

Returning and No Other Options

They decide to return and believe there are no other options.

Imposter Exclamation

There is a repeated exclamation of 'Imposter!'

Assigning Responsibility

Someone should be responsible for killing enemies.

Splitting Up

They decide to split up and go in different directions.

Hole and Steam

There is a hole in the area with steam coming from it.

Voice Changer and Dead End

A voice changer and a dead end are detected.

Negation

A simple 'No' is stated.

Finding a Way Out

They are trying to find a way out.

Exploring a Dead End

The characters are exploring a dead end.

Rounds and Potential Death

Participants are discussing the remaining rounds and a potential death outcome.

Toilet Paper for Emotional Support

Speaker offers toilet paper for emotional support.

Holding Something Open

Someone held something open, believing others had seen it.

Encouragement

Someone encourages another.

Day After Tomorrow

They are discussing the day after tomorrow.

relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: にぎやかな大人数戦を結果だけで追わず、カモフラージュが色、地形、時間、囮の四つを調整する情報戦だと分かる

relatedStreams.title: 最後まで着替えて、撮って、ありがとうを言う　FUWAMOCOのHoloearth送別配信
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 終了告知そのものではなく、FUWAMOCOが『最後だから見る』だけで終わらせず、着替える・撮る・遊ぶ・感謝するという形で思い出を作り直した流れを読める

relatedStreams.title: Claims Analysis
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: The analysis includes a variety of claims, ranging from expressing excitement and agreement to discussing specific topics and the quality of items.

relatedStreams.title: 鍛冶の準備がダンジョン攻略を支える　Fuwawa視点で追うENigmatic Recollection
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: パズルや戦闘だけでなく、事前の調達、製作、交易、パーティ編成が共同攻略の成功条件になったことが分かる

relatedStreams.title: FUWAMOCOが香りを紹介　双子で違うフレグランスと記憶をたどるクイズ
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: FUWAMOCOそれぞれの香りの構成と本人たちの感想、試香、クイズを原文の時刻とともに追い、商品説明と推量を区別できる。
